## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (or `make test-short` if Docker is unavailable, and say so above)
- [ ] `make ui-test` passes, if `web/ui/` changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`), and `bash docs/docs-check.sh` passes if the user guide changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] If this touches hooks, gates, tokens or signing: the description explains the effect on the safety model
